name: State Medical Equipment
old_description: We are a family and locally owned durable medical supply company committed to providing our customers with the best quality medical supplies and exceptional customer service. We have nearly a decade of experience, serving patients and healthcare facilities with sales and rental solutions across the Las Vegas Valley.
about:
State Medical Equipment is a family-owned durable medical equipment supplier based in Las Vegas, Nevada. Established nearly a decade ago, the company serves the Las Vegas Valley, including Henderson, Summerlin, and surrounding communities in Southern Nevada.

The company sells and rents a broad range of home medical equipment, including mobility aids such as wheelchairs, scooters, walkers, and power chairs; respiratory devices like oxygen concentrators and nebulizers; hospital beds and patient lifts; power lift chairs; and bathroom safety products such as shower chairs, commodes, and grab bars. It operates a retail showroom where customers can view equipment in person, and provides in-home delivery, installation, and setup. A dedicated after-hours team offers emergency support outside normal business hours, and the company also performs professional service and repair on medical equipment.

State Medical Equipment serves individual patients, caregivers, and healthcare facilities, as well as visitors to Las Vegas who need temporary equipment. Testimonials highlight travelers who forgot CPAP components and received replacements within hours, families renting wheelchairs and lift chairs for elderly relatives, and facilities arranging hospital bed rentals on short notice.

The company emphasizes its highly trained staff, transparent pricing, and rapid response — including after-hours delivery — as key differentiators. Its combination of a physical retail location, comprehensive rental programs, and on-site service capabilities allows it to support both short-term visitor needs and long-term home care requirements.
type_evidence: Durable medical equipment, home medical supplies, and short-term rentals from a local team you can reach.
